description: A library for working with Bitcoin
readme_summary: image:https://github.com/bitcoinj/bitcoinj/workflows/Java%20CI/badge.svg[GitHub Build Status,link=https://github.com/bitcoinj/bitcoinj/actions] image:https://gitlab.com/bitcoinj/bitcoinj/badges/master/pipeline.svg[GitLab Build Status,link=https://gitlab.com/bitcoinj/bitcoinj/-/pipelines] image:https://coveralls.io/repos/bitcoinj/bitcoinj/badge.png?branch=master[Coverage Status,link=https://coveralls.io/r/bitcoinj/bitcoinj?branch=master] image::https://img.shields.io/badge/chat-Join%20bitcoinj--users%20on%20Matrix-blue[Join the bitcoinj-users Matrix room, link=https://matrix.to/#/#bitcoinj-users:matrix.org] The bitcoinj library is a Java implementation of the Bitcoin protocol, which allows it to maintain a wallet and send/receive transactions without needing a local copy of Bitcoin Core. It comes with full documentation and some example apps showing how to use it.
